name: SPORC Clinic Rawalpindi
description: Official clinic website for SPORC Clinic Rawalpindi (Sports & Orthopedic Rehabilitation Center), located opposite Benazir Bhutto Hospital on Murree Road, Rawalpindi. Specializing in sports injury rehabilitation, orthopedic physical therapy, spine pain relief, joint mobilization, and post-surgical recovery by Dr. Iftikhar Ali.
